subject: Quick check — estimate delivered, available to walk through?

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Estimate & deck from today’s discovery — next steps

Hi Sandeep — great conversation today, thank you for the time. I summarized the scope and attached a tailored estimate and our pricing deck for Nimbus Health. Key points below:

- Scope: 3 production endpoints (text gen + embeddings), batching & autoscale for peak hours, SOC2-compliant Private deploy option
- Estimate: baseline monthly run-rate + one-time onboarding (see attached PDF)
- Suggested next step: 30-minute walkthrough of the deck and cost model with Olga (solutions engineer) to align on perf expectations and deployment option

Attachments: nimbus_estimate_Q4-2026.pdf, redwood_pricing_deck_v3.pdf

Suggested times (PT):
- Tue Dec 1 — 9:00–9:30am
- Wed Dec 2 — 11:00–11:30am

Could you confirm receipt and let me know which time (if any) works? If timing/priority has shifted, just say the word and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priYom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Hi Sandeep — just bumping this in case the deck/estimate landed in a busy inbox. I want to make sure you have the numbers to share with procurement if you’re moving forward.

If it’s easier, Olga can do a 20-minute focused walkthrough on the cost model and perf tradeoffs. Are you available Tue Dec 1 9:00am PT (same as suggested) or Wed Dec 2 11:00am PT?

No pressure — if now isn’t the right time, a quick "not now" is perfectly fine.

Best,

Sandeep — one more quick note on timing and next steps, since we’re planning resources on our side if Nimbus wants to proceed in Q4:

Mutual action plan (proposed)
- Week 1: Walkthrough + clarify data handling / network topology (Olga)
- Week 2: Pilot contract and SOC2 evidence package request (we can provide templates)
- Week 3–4: Pilot kickoff + instrumented metrics for latency/cost

If budget or priority changed since the call, tell me and I’ll pause the deck follow-ups. If you want, Olga can run a short technical walkthrough that focuses only on the PII/data handling and latency SLOs (15–20 mins).

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so we can keep the timeline realistic.

Priyom
